Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 615 PM EST Tue Nov 17 2026
 

- Dry weather during the week with above normal temperatures.

- Next chance for precipitation arrives this weekend with a cold 
frontal passage.

&&

.AVIATION...

SE MI remains under the influence of Ohio Valley high pressure 
overnight resulting in light southwesterly winds. While some cirrus 
does work into the region, its unclear if it will be enough to 
prevent the otherwise favorable radiative cooling tonight which 
would offer shallow fog potential. Given the uncertainty, have 
maintained running MVFR fog mentions in the south early Wednesday 
morning. 

For DTW... Potential still there for shallow radiative fog 
development early Wednesday morning before burning off after sunrise.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* None.
